title: Council bites back as bulldozed VicRoads site slated for up to 16 storeys
summary: Coverage of the proposed 60 Denmark Street masterplan: up to 630 homes across nine buildings, including two towers of up to 16 storeys, and a reported response from Boroondara Council. This is a local planning issue; the article does not establish how representative any expressed views are.

title: An important milestone for Kew Recreation Centre
summary: Council reported that the structural steel installation had been completed and the tower crane removed, with further fit-out work continuing across the aquatic, fitness and recreation facilities. Official project reporting; not independent resident feedback.

title: Kew Recreation Centre to open in mid-2027
feed_query: Kew Recreation Centre delay and reopening
summary: Council stated that the centre was expected to reopen in July 2027, following construction completion and operator preparation. The article attributes delays to the earlier roof collapse, investigations and legal proceedings, as well as a heating-system change. This records the council's update, not public sentiment.

title: Kew Recreation Centre July 2026 progress report
summary: Council's July progress update describes works to the pools, sports courts, foyer, fitness areas and carpark. This is an official construction progress report, not an assessment of resident satisfaction.
